_description: A lesson containing multiple activities (Activate → Explore → Reflect → Practice).
title: Function Families for 200, Alex
lessonSummary: Recognizing Functions by Characteristics. Students identify function families from graphical characteristics, write equations that satisfy given constraints, and sketch graphs from verbal descriptions.
learningGoals: I can interpret key features of a function in terms of the situation it represents.
I can sketch a graph showing key features of a function, given a verbal description.
